name: 40 new six-metre missions, policy_best, 2026-11-13

selection.start_sampling: Uniform XY over inset map bounds, followed by category and zone rejection
selection.goal_sampling: Uniform bearing [-pi, pi); goal = start + 6 m unit bearing
selection.initial_yaw: Independent uniform [-pi, pi); fixed before execution
selection.regular: No ice/stairs, <=3 traversable terrain types; 0.55 m clearance from hazard cells. Rocks and asphalt allowed.
selection.regular_zone_definition: Start-goal midpoint; west/east split X=18 m; south/north split Y=9 m
selection.ice: One ice cell crossed through adjacent edges; 0.4 to 1.6 m chord; no stairs; local outside-corner alternative <=1.45x direct length
selection.stairs: At least 1 m stairs on the direct segment, no ice
selection.surface_choice: At least 1.5 m rocks on direct segment; one-bend alternative contains >=0.75 m asphalt and >=1 m less rocks/obstacles; original length ratio 1.08 to 1.8
selection.energy_note: Alternative surface exposure is geometric evidence, not a measured energy ranking
selection.category_priority: Ice and stairs separated; surface_choice before regular
selection.design_note: New prospective panel after preliminary tests, with changed geometric criteria and selected policy_best checkpoint

path_note: Assigned start and goal only. Selection waypoints never constrain the policy. Previous missions and results stay separate.
